verification.title: Verification
verification.description: Your badge reflects what we have verified and how you behave. It cannot be bought.
verification.paused: Your badge is paused because your trust score is below the threshold. Responding quickly to leads and closing the loop on deals raises it.

t0.name: T0 Phone verified
t0.body: Your mobile number is confirmed by OTP.

t1.name: T1 GST verified
t1.body: Your GSTIN is checked with the GST network. Shows the GST verified badge and improves your ranking.

t2.name: T2 KYC verified
t2.body: Document checks and a short video KYC of the owner. Shows the KYC verified badge.

t3.name: T3 Audited
t3.body: Physical or partner audit, for categories that need it. Arranged by our team.

gst.label: GSTIN
gst.hintEmpty: 15 characters, like 27AAPFU0939F1ZV. You can find it on your GST certificate.
gst.badPattern: This does not look like a GSTIN. Check the letters and digits.
gst.badChecksum: Last character does not match. Check for a typing mistake.
gst.failed: We could not verify this GSTIN. {reason}
gst.defaultReason: Check the number matches your registration and try again.
gst.passed: GST verified. Your badge now shows GST verified.
gst.errGstin: This GSTIN does not look right. Check it and try again.

gst_certificate.label: GST registration certificate
gst_certificate.tips: Page 1 of the GST REG-06 certificate. GSTIN, legal name and address must be readable.

pan_card.label: PAN card
pan_card.tips: Photo of the PAN card of the business or proprietor. Name and PAN number must be readable.

bank_proof.label: Bank proof
bank_proof.tips: Optional. Cancelled cheque or first page of a statement. Only the last 4 digits of the account are kept.

address_proof.label: Address proof
address_proof.tips: Optional. Electricity bill or rent agreement page showing the business address.

kyc.uploadHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB. No PDFs yet: photograph or screenshot page 1.
kyc.expired: Your last KYC attempt expired. Start again; it takes about 10 minutes.
kyc.intro: You will need your GST certificate and PAN card, then a short video check on your phone (a live selfie matched to your PAN photo). Only the owner or authorised signatory can do this.
kyc.approved: KYC verified. Your badge now shows Tier 2.
kyc.rejectedNote: We could not verify your KYC: {note} Contact support to try again with corrected documents.
kyc.rejected: We could not verify your KYC. Contact support to try again with corrected documents.
kyc.inReview: Submitted. A verification officer is reviewing your documents. This usually takes one working day.
kyc.videoStarted: Video check started. Finish it on the provider page; this page updates when the result arrives. <link>Refresh</link>
kyc.videoBody: A hosted page opens on your phone or computer camera: a live selfie and a short liveness check. We keep only the result scores, never the video or face template.
kyc.uploadFirst: Upload the GST certificate and PAN card first.

t3.none: Only categories that need it are audited. If yours does, our team will contact you.
t3.requested: An audit by {partner} has been requested. We will confirm a date with you.
t3.scheduled: Audit by {partner} scheduled for {date}. Keep your premises and stock records ready.
t3.scheduledTbc: Audit by {partner} scheduled for a date to be confirmed. Keep your premises and stock records ready.
t3.conditionalBody: Our team will follow up on the open points.
t3.expiredOn: Your last audit lapsed on {date}. Contact support to renew.
t3.expiredBody: Your last audit lapsed. Contact support to renew.
t3.failedBody: Contact support to discuss next steps.
